answer: Before an agent may sell goods like nectar, timber or walnut in the market, it locks a bond of 500 tokens for ten epochs, and peers check that the bond came from one wallet with its own past activity. Faking 100 sellers therefore freezes 50,000 tokens for weeks, and splitting one fund across many fresh wallets fails because new, empty wallets are refused. An honest agent posts the bond once and gets it back in full when it leaves, so honest trade costs only the wait.
